narrative_summary: SPX closed 7,357.49 right on the flattening 50-day SMA and the 61.8% fib after fully retracing the May-June advance, with the engine re-anchoring downside to the 7,351 caution/liquidation zone. The mechanically intact bull skeleton (50d > 200d, +6.3% over the 200-day, benign VIX ~18.9) is colliding with a zero-cushion ERP (~0.06%), 9+ sessions of Extreme Fear breadth and wide credit, deteriorating sentiment (F&G 26), and a 78.8% down-first Monte Carlo edge. With no valuation cushion, no breadth/credit confirmation, and price sitting on its last mechanical support, defensive patience with a trim bias — not re-entry — remains the only justified posture.
